mechanism_narrative: A stable or declining federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is stable or declining, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.8% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises above 4.8% in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contractions (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing output declines reduce corporate profitability and trigger negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC for INDPRO < 100 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strengthening consumer spending, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation requiring Fed tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), higher policy rates increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC for tightening cycle is below 0.03.
